name: estimating-frontend-checks
description: Dev-only checks for the static SPA in frontend/. Nothing here ships — the app has no build step and FastAPI serves frontend/ as-is.

scripts.check: for f in frontend/assets/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax OK'
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
